narrative: His part for the old man in Errors, open at the top of the roll and blank of any later cue he would need. A chair back, the side of the stage, his hand at the margin. His face is not on the page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Opened the play and stayed idle after it.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
